– Eight-part paranormal series follows Snooki (MTV’s JERSEY SHORE) as she teams up with a paranormal investigation team to uncover unsettling mysteries across Ontario –
– From historic mansions and prisons to a heritage village in Peterborough and Niagara Falls, the series investigates some of the country’s most haunted locations –

TORONTO (September 10, 2026) – From Jersey Shore to spirits galore! Reality television icon Nicole “Snooki” Polizzi trades beachside adventures for haunted halls in SNOOKI: THE PARANORMAL ROOKIE, a spine-tingling new Crave Original series that follows Snooki as she explores the stories, secrets, and spirits said to inhabit some of Canada’s most intriguing locations. The eight-episode, hour-long unscripted series launches October 2 with the first two episodes, followed by two all-new episodes released every Friday. With no formal paranormal training, but a lifelong connection and unwavering belief in the unknown, Snooki joins an expert team of investigators to explore some of Canada’s reportedly most haunted locations. Alongside internationally acclaimed psychic medium Kevin Whitaker, occult expert and historian Missy Morrow, and paranormal tech specialist Todd Thomas, Snooki faces chilling encounters, unexplained phenomena, and startling discoveries that challenge everything she thought she knew about the spirit world. Filmed across eight episodes at historic and reportedly haunted sites throughout Ontario, the team’s investigations include Tuckett Mansion in Hamilton, Fulford Place in Brockville, Huron Historic Gaol in Goderich, a heritage village in Peterborough, Old Fort Erie, and the Niagara Parks Power Station and Loretto Academy – a historic 19th-century convent and school in Niagara Falls. What begins as a curiosity-driven adventure quickly evolves into a deeply personal journey as Snooki develops her instincts and confidence in the field, transforming from a paranormal novice into an increasingly capable investigator.

Click here for a sneak peek at SNOOKI: THE PARANORMAL ROOKIE

On the series premiere, Snooki begins her paranormal journey at the infamous Tuckett Mansion in Hamilton, Ont., where a playful spirit soon gives way to evidence of a far darker entity lurking within the historic building.  Episode 2 follows Snooki and the team as they descend into the Huron Historic Gaol in Goderich, Ont., where the ghost of a hanged prisoner, unexplained blood, and the presence of a young girl transform the investigation into a chilling encounter with the past. SNOOKI: THE PARANORMAL ROOKIE is produced by Buck Productions and My Entertainment in association with Crave. Executive producers are Sean Buckley, Jim Kiriakakis, Nicole “Snooki” Polizzi, and Justin Stockman. Kyle Whitelaw serves as showrunner and director. Produced with the participation of the Canadian Film or Video Production Tax Credit.
